name: Citizen
description: Individuals in the regular working population, including corporate workers, colonists, and labourers.

assignments.name: Corporate
assignments.description: You are a white-collar worker in a large corporation.

assignments.name: Worker
assignments.description: You are a blue-collar worker on an industrial planet.

assignments.name: Colonist
assignments.description: You are a colonist building a new life on a recently settled world.

events.description: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Mishap table but remain in career.

effects.detail: Roll on Mishap table, stay in career

events.description: Political upheaval strikes your homeworld and you are caught up in the revolution.
events.effectDescription: Roll Streetwise 8+ or Deception 8+. Succeed: gain an extra Benefit roll. Fail: roll on the Injury table.

effects.detail: Streetwise/Deception 8+ for extra Benefit or Injury

events.description: You spend time maintaining and using heavy vehicles.
events.effectDescription: Gain one of Drive 1, Electronics 1, Flyer 1 or Mechanic 1.

effects.detail: Gain Drive 1, Electronics 1, Flyer 1 or Mechanic 1

events.description: Your business or employment is thriving.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.

events.description: You are given advanced training in a specialist field.
events.effectDescription: Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.

events.description: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Life Events table.

events.description: You learn something you should not have and people want to kill you for it. Gain an Enemy and gain Deception 1, Streetwise 1 or a Contact.
events.effectDescription: Gain an Enemy. Gain Deception 1, Streetwise 1 or a Contact.
Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.

events.description: You are rewarded for your diligence or brilliance.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll and gain an Ally.

events.description: You gain experience in a wide variety of fields.
You rise to a position of power in your organisation.

mishaps.effectDescription: Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.

effects.detail: Roll twice on Injury table, take lower result

mishaps.description: You are harassed and your life is ruined by a criminal gang. Gain the gang as an Enemy.
mishaps.effectDescription: Gain a criminal gang as an Enemy.

mishaps.description: Hard times caused by a lack of interstellar trade costs you your job.
Your business is consumed by a new and unexpected rival.
mishaps.effectDescription: Gain a Rival. Gain Broker 1 or Electronics 1.

mishaps.description: A revolution, attack or other unusual event throws your life into chaos, forcing you to leave the planet.
mishaps.effectDescription: Roll Streetwise 8+. If you succeed, increase one skill. If you fail, increase Deception or Streetwise.

effects.detail: Streetwise 8+ for any skill or Deception/Streetwise

mishaps.description: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
